what: next/ version. The P19 slice 1 lane (the brain as a launchd service on a Mac) went through eleven reviews. Decision 0076 sends a lane to the owner when 3 of its last 5 steps were sends back. That limit was not applied while it was reached, because the lanes run by hand and nothing counted. The owner chose to cut scope on 2026-11-13: the pull request lands now, and the one fault review 11 left is a tracker ticket. The fault: a kill inside a window of a few milliseconds can leave our own plist in a hidden .brain-* folder, and then removing the service from an empty path answers Conflict until the file is moved by hand.
cause: In the hand-run pipeline the send-back count is read by the lead from memory, not by code. Each review found one more small fault, so no single send back looked like the limit.
fix: A Check that counts the last 5 step outcomes of a lane from its state file and asks the owner on the third send back, as 0076 says.
test: Property: for any list of 5 step outcomes with 3 or more sends back, the Check answers ask; with fewer, it does not.
